build_posevis_graph: build a PoseVis graph by calling PoseVisRunner.build to register nodes and enable extensions
run_posevis_graph: run the PoseVis graph using PoseVisRunner.run with labgraph ParallelRunner and logger config
create_posevis_config: create a PoseVisConfig dataclass with extensions, log directory, display framerate, and stats settings
review_posevisrunner_abstract_class: review the PoseVisRunner abstract class and its register_nodes method for subclass implementation
refactor_posevisrunner_display_logic: refactor PoseVisRunner.build to customize Display node or TerminationHandler connection logic
